criteria.c2: reward resolution or variation is a designed or measured moderator
criteria.c3: supervision breadth or call-content eligibility is experimentally varied
criteria.c4: moderator-by-supervision interaction is estimated or central
criteria.c5: strict success, stability, or sample-efficiency evidence

works.title: TurnSight: Turn-Level Hindsight Self-Distillation for Tool-Integrated Reasoning
works.closest_threat: Turn-level execution-conditioned hindsight is normalized across sibling rollouts and modulates GRPO advantages.
works.non_overlap: No pre-treatment strict-reward-resolution moderator and no AF/LF/AN/LN eligibility experiment.

works.title: SERL-SQL: Selective Hindsight Distillation for Text-to-SQL Reinforcement Agentic Learning
works.closest_threat: Ablates a selective mask that applies hindsight reweighting only to executable SQL and tool-action spans.
works.non_overlap: Domain-specific action versus non-action weighting; no all/last or name/full crossing and no reward-resolution moderation.

works.title: TACO: Tool-Augmented Credit Optimization for Agentic Tool Use
works.closest_threat: Outcome-gated routing masks outcome advantage to responsible action segments and adds call-level contribution credit.
works.non_overlap: Call contribution is an endogenous credit signal, not a pre-training group-reward-resolution moderator; no four-cell eligibility factorial.

works.title: PACT: Privileged Trace Co-Training for Multi-Turn Tool-Use Agents
works.closest_threat: Component-aware SFT supervises selected reasoning prefixes and complete tool-call spans and ablates tool-call supervision.
works.non_overlap: Changes expert-trace SFT/RL composition and annealing; it neither measures conditional reward resolution nor tests all/last and name/full policy-gradient eligibility.

works.title: Why Multi-Step Tool-Use Reinforcement Learning Collapses and How Supervisory Signals Fix It
works.closest_threat: Compares multiple SFT/RL supervisory regimes and directly studies catastrophic tool-format collapse and generalization.
works.non_overlap: Supervision source and schedule are varied, not action-span eligibility; reward resolution is not a moderator.

works.title: Learning CLI Agents with Structured Action Credit under Selective Observation
works.closest_threat: Constructs turn-level action advantages from episode-relative feedback and structured CLI subchains.
works.non_overlap: Changes the credit estimator and observation policy rather than experimentally crossing fixed action-span masks with reward resolution.

works.title: Keep Policy Gradient in Charge: Sibling-Guided Credit Distillation for Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
works.closest_threat: Uses mixed successful/failed sibling rollouts to reshape token advantages and reports AppWorld and tau3 outcomes.
works.non_overlap: Sibling contrast creates a credit signal; it does not condition a supervision-topology treatment effect on independently measured reward resolution.

works.title: CacheRL: Multi-Turn Tool-Calling Agents via Cached Rollouts and Hybrid Reward
works.closest_threat: Uses token masking, hybrid reward, and iterative SFT plus GRPO in multi-step tool calling.
works.non_overlap: Masking protects cached-environment fidelity and is not the causal all/last by name/full treatment.

works.title: Getting the Parameters Right: A Difficulty-Graded Benchmark and Probe-Guided Training for LLM Tool Calls
works.closest_threat: Directly isolates tool-parameter correctness and provides difficulty-graded evaluation.
works.non_overlap: Probe filtering/reranking targets parameter correctness without group-relative reward resolution or supervision-topology training arms.

works.title: ToolLIFT: Lifting Tool-Specific Trajectories into Function-Level Graphs for Generalizable Tool Planning
works.closest_threat: Uses source-gated and skill-specific rewards for multi-call workflow learning.
works.non_overlap: Optimizes workflow abstraction and reward design, not static action-span eligibility under a resolution moderator.
